assessment_scope: Numerical error and structured support/qualification consistency are separate. No required positive effect, free-text rationale score, native-specific tolerance or population-inference claim is introduced.

count_fields.task_requirement: Report the corresponding counts from the index.

cells.identities: All unique cell_id values from the index. Canonical order: split train then val; segment 0 through 5; eye 0 then 1; direction 0 then 180. ID format {split}-segment{segment}-eye{eye}-direction{direction}.
cells.numerical_definition: For each quarter let d be the 270 long-minus-short prior mean rate differences over 54 units and 5 bins. Signed mean=sum(d)/270; RMS=sqrt(sum(d*d)/270). Units are Hz. Prior rates are equal-trial averages of count/actual-bin-exposure, not pooled-count/exposure averages.

supported_values.quarter_rms_hz: Array of four finite nonnegative real numbers, excluding booleans.
supported_values.quarter_signed_mean_hz: Array of four finite real numbers, excluding booleans.

cells.task_support_rule: A cell is supported only when both source prior counts are positive. Preserve all cells, including unsupported ones.

submission_encoding: UTF-8 JSON object; reject duplicate keys, NaN, Infinity and finite-looking numeric overflow; no surrounding prose.
